question: On exactly the already-consumed DGR-016 synthetic/repo-owned bytes, is deterministic local augmenting-path matching rather than unchanged minimax ranking responsible for valid 16-cell assignment, when directly contrasted against original greedy first-free placement?
hypothesis: Holding R016 candidate pool, minimax score/rank, capacity, radius, encounter orders, data and evaluation fixed, matched placement retains six valid stages while legacy greedy placement fails to place sixteen motifs in at least one stage; a greedy failure is an observed outcome and must not be silently classified as infrastructure invalid.

predecessor_evidence.observed_note: Two greedy local assignment failures; this is historical, not fresh unseen evidence.

predecessor_evidence.classification: validity metrics and frozen 016 thresholds satisfied; no new scientific result claimed here

inputs.name: R016 immutable repo-owned base and A/B/C byte splits, matched 015-016
inputs.source: Yggdrasil branch pinned by exact_parent_sha, prior consumed source only

arms.A0: Run exact R016 matched placement (immutable original control) and require byte-identical frozen R016 result identity before interpreting A1
arms.A1: Use R016's exact ranked candidate stream and per-stage chosen candidate identities, but place them by R015 first-free local order without augmenting-path reassignment, feasibility skip, radius extension, candidate-substitution or extra capacity

frozen_design.split: Exactly reused 016 committed source/splits: no prospective unseen-data claim and no hidden source reads
frozen_design.evaluator: Record placement success/failure before performance; compare only stages where both A0/A1 are structurally valid; do not impute invalid-stage accuracy

controls: A0 must reproduce exact frozen 016 result identity and six structurally valid 16-cell stages before inspecting A1 outcomes.
A0 fixed 16/7/9, same 16-ring home hash and radius 2, frozen minimax ranks and candidate set; no threshold or budget changes.

A1 changes only assignment algorithm (greedy first-free in frozen local-cell order). Candidate ordering, source splits, first-half contribution scores, motif scoring and selection must match A0 before placement.
A1 unplaced motifs are recorded as a causal placement failure, not silently dropped, reclassified as infrastructure, padded or given extra capacity.
No future-stage information, second-half adaptation information, future outputs, external model, or evaluator label influences either placement.

classification_rules.supported: A0 exact 016 controls valid and no rank/input drift; A1 greedy fails structural assignment in at least one of six stages, attributing a placement-validity advantage to augmenting-path matching on reused source.
classification_rules.mixed: A0 exact controls pass; greedy and matched both valid in all stages, but one or more structurally valid stage placements differ and matched accuracy is better on at least one common-valid stage; report complete paired metrics.
classification_rules.negative: A0 exact controls pass and all greedy placements succeed with no consistent matched validity or performance advantage.
classification_rules.invalid: A0 exact 016 identity differs, frozen rank or source drifts, either arm uses different capacity/geometry, evaluator leakage occurs, unsupported failure is masked, or duplicate deterministic replay disagrees.

interpretation_limits: This is a causal placement ablation on already-used evidence, NOT a new blind evaluation or proof of broad language competence. Prior 015/016 outcomes inform the hypothesis; only the independently preregistered paired ablation may be classified under these rules.
preregistration_note: Revision ahead of any primary scientific run; adds read-only hosted CI qualification workflow only; previously committed mechanical code remains unchanged. Primary execution remains unauthorized.
